preconditions.description: The number of jobs N must be between 1 and 100.
The number of applicants M must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: len(G) == N and all(len(row) == M for row in G)
preconditions.description: The matrix G must have N rows and each row must have M columns.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of applicants who can get a job.
